name: humanlinkpay_transfer
description: Send a payment intent to the local HumanlinkPay gateway. High-risk payments trigger HumanLink biometric authorization before broadcasting the Sepolia transfer.

amount.description: ETH amount expressed as a decimal string, for example 0.005.

purpose.description: Human-readable payment purpose shown in the HumanLink authorization prompt.

userId.description: Optional agent user id. Defaults to demo-user.

token.description: Optional token symbol. Only ETH is currently supported.

deadline.description: Optional ISO 8601 deadline for the payment intent.

nonce.description: Optional client-provided nonce. If omitted, the adapter generates one.
